    def merge(left, right):
        nonlocal comparisons
        result = []
        i = j = 0
        
        while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
            comparisons += 1
            if left[i] <= right[j]:
                result.append(left[i])
                i += 1
            else:
                result.append(right[j])
                j += 1
        
        # Add remaining elements
        result.extend(left[i:])
        result.extend(right[j:])
        
        return result
    
    def sort(arr):
        if len(arr) <= 1:
            return arr
        
        mid = len(arr) // 2
        left = sort(arr[:mid])
        right = sort(arr[mid:])
        
        return merge(left, right)
    
    sorted_arr = sort(arr)
    return sorted_arr, comparisons

import sys

def merge(arr, left, mid, right):
    L = arr[left:mid + 1]
    R = arr[mid + 1:right + 1]

    i = 0
    j = 0
    k = left
    comparisons = 0

    while i < len(L) and j < len(R):
        comparisons += 1
        if L[i] <= R[j]:
            arr[k] = L[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            arr[k] = R[j]
            j += 1
        k += 1

    while i < len(L):
        arr[k] = L[i]
        i += 1
        k += 1

    while j < len(R):
        arr[k] = R[j]
        j += 1
        k += 1

    return comparisons

def merge_sort(arr, left, right):
    comparisons = 0
    if left < right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        comparisons += merge_sort(arr, left, mid)
        comparisons += merge_sort(arr, mid + 1, right)
        comparisons += merge(arr, left, mid, right)
    return comparisons

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().strip().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    n = data[0]
    arr = data[1:1 + n]

    comparisons = merge_sort(arr, 0, n - 1) if n > 0 else 0

    print(*arr)
    print(comparisons)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
